behavior: Failure propagation waits for owned process exit, log closure and once-only lock release.
SIGINT has a 15 second bound, then SIGKILL has a 5 second exit-confirmation bound. Unconfirmed cleanup returns a stable error.
The same cleanup owns explicit stop and parent SIGINT/SIGTERM.
Pre-spawn and failed-spawn paths release the lock. Running-child errors do not falsely prove process exit.
Readiness polling is cancelled during cleanup. Log errors are handled without exposing native details.
testBoundary: Temporary installed electron fixture resolves to the actual Node executable. The launcher really spawns, signals, waits and drains local evidence. No Electron or credential mocks enter product runtime.
